home.faq.items.q: Are all tools on UploadLess free to use?
home.faq.items.a: Yes. All tools on UploadLess are free to use. You do not need to pay, subscribe, or create an account to compress files, convert formats, extract text, generate barcodes, or use other browser-based utilities.

home.faq.items.q: Do I need to upload my files to a server?
home.faq.items.a: No. UploadLess is designed to process files directly in your browser whenever possible. Your files stay on your device instead of being uploaded to a remote server, which makes the tools faster and more private for everyday use.

home.faq.items.q: How does UploadLess process files in the browser?
home.faq.items.a: Many tools use modern browser technologies such as WebAssembly to run file processing locally on your device. This allows tasks like video compression, PDF compression, OCR, audio conversion, and format conversion to work without traditional server-side uploads.

home.faq.items.q: Do I need to create an account?
home.faq.items.a: No. UploadLess does not require registration. You can open the tool you need, choose your file, process it in the browser, and download the result without signing up or entering an email address.

home.faq.items.q: What kind of tools are available on UploadLess?
home.faq.items.a: UploadLess includes free tools for video compression, audio and video conversion, PDF compression, image compression, OCR, audio or video transcription, barcode generation, extracting frames from video, text utilities, and more practical file tools.

home.faq.items.q: Is UploadLess safe for private files?
home.faq.items.a: UploadLess is built with privacy in mind. Since processing happens locally in your browser for supported tools, your files are not sent to UploadLess servers. This is useful for personal documents, work files, recordings, screenshots, and other sensitive files.

home.faq.items.q: Is there a file size limit?
home.faq.items.a: There is no typical upload limit because files are processed on your own device, not uploaded to a server. However, very large files may still be limited by your browser, memory, storage, or device performance. A newer or more powerful device will usually handle bigger files better.

home.faq.items.q: Why does the first run take longer for some tools?
home.faq.items.a: Some tools need to load browser-based processing libraries or AI models the first time you use them. After the first load, your browser may cache these files, so later uses are usually faster.

home.faq.items.q: Can I use UploadLess on mobile?
home.faq.items.a: Yes. UploadLess works in modern mobile browsers on phones and tablets. Smaller files usually work well on mobile, while larger videos, PDFs, or AI-based tasks may run better on a desktop or laptop with more memory and processing power.

home.faq.items.q: When should I use UploadLess instead of an online file converter?
home.faq.items.a: Use UploadLess when you want quick, free file tools without uploading your files to a third-party server. It is especially useful for simple tasks like compressing a video, reducing a PDF size, converting audio, extracting text from an image, or getting a transcript from a file directly in your browser.

extract_frames.faq.title: Extract Frames FAQ

extract_frames.faq.items.q: What is a video frame extractor?
extract_frames.faq.items.a: A video frame extractor is a tool that saves still images from a video. Instead of taking a screen capture, it reads the video frame directly and lets you save it as an image.

extract_frames.faq.items.q: How do I extract frames from a video online?
extract_frames.faq.items.a: Upload your video, choose an extraction mode, and start the process. You can save the current frame, extract frames at a time interval, or capture a fixed number of frames from the video.

extract_frames.faq.items.q: How do I save one exact frame from a video?
extract_frames.faq.items.a: Use the current frame mode, move the preview to the moment you want, then save that frame as a JPG image. This is useful when you need one precise image from a video.

extract_frames.faq.items.q: Can I take a clean screenshot from a video?
extract_frames.faq.items.a: Yes. You can save the video frame itself as a JPG image, without browser controls, player buttons, or other screen elements appearing in the screenshot.

extract_frames.faq.items.q: How do I extract frames every few seconds?
extract_frames.faq.items.a: Choose interval mode and enter the number of seconds between frames. For example, you can extract one frame every 1, 2, 5, or 10 seconds.

extract_frames.faq.items.q: How do I extract a fixed number of frames from a video?
extract_frames.faq.items.a: Choose count mode and enter how many frames you want. The tool will capture that number of frames evenly across the full video duration.

extract_frames.faq.items.q: Should I extract every frame from a video?

merge_pdf.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: No. The merging process happens entirely within your browser on your device, so your files never leave your computer or get transmitted to any server. This makes the tool a safe choice for merging sensitive documents like contracts, ID scans, or financial statements.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: Can I rearrange the files before merging?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: Yes. You can drag and drop the uploaded files to change their order before generating the final PDF. This lets you control exactly how the pages from each file appear in the combined document, without needing a separate page-reordering tool afterward.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: Is there a limit on the number of files I can merge?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: There is no strict limit. However, your device's memory may restrict merging a very large number of files or extremely large PDFs, since everything is processed locally rather than on a remote server.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: Is this PDF merger really free to use?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: Yes, merging PDF files and images is completely free, with no hidden fees, subscriptions, or watermarks added to your output. There's also no daily limit on how many times you can merge files, unlike many online tools that cap free usage.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: Do I need to create an account or enter my email to merge PDFs?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: No account, email address, or sign-up is required. Just open the tool in your browser, add your files, and download the merged PDF right away — the entire process is anonymous.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: Can I merge PDF files together with images like JPG or PNG?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: Yes. You can mix PDF documents with JPG and PNG images in the same merge, and each image is automatically converted into a page within the final PDF. This is useful for combining scanned receipts, photos, or screenshots with existing PDF documents.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: Will merging my PDFs reduce their quality or add a watermark?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: No. Merging only combines the pages from your original files into a new document without re-compressing, re-encoding, or altering their content, so quality is fully preserved. The tool also never adds a watermark or branding to your merged PDF.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: Can I merge PDF files on Mac, Windows, iPhone, or Android?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: Yes. Since the tool runs entirely in your web browser, it works on Mac, Windows, Linux, and Chromebook computers, as well as iPhone and Android devices, with no software or app to install.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: How do I merge two or more PDF files into one document?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: Add your PDF files by dragging them into the tool or selecting them from your device, then arrange them in the order you want and click 'Merge Files'. You can combine just two PDFs or dozens of files at once, and the result is a single downloadable PDF.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: Can I merge large PDF files or scanned documents?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: Yes, you can merge large PDFs and scanned documents, though processing speed depends on your device's available memory since merging happens locally rather than on a server. For very large files, using an up-to-date desktop browser will generally give the smoothest experience.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: How is my data kept private and secure when merging online?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: Your data stays private because the files are processed using your browser's built-in capabilities and never get sent over the internet. There's no server-side storage, so there's nothing to be hacked, leaked, or retained after you close the tab.

merge_pdf.faq.items.q: How is this different from other free PDF merge tools?
merge_pdf.faq.items.a: Most online PDF mergers require uploading your files to a remote server, which means your documents pass through someone else's infrastructure before you get them back. This tool processes everything locally in your browser instead, so it combines the convenience of a free PDF merge tool with the privacy of offline software.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: No. All renaming happens locally in your browser — your files never leave your device. That makes it a truly private file renamer with no server, no storage, and no tracking of your file contents.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Is this bulk file renamer free to use?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: Yes, it's completely free with no sign-up, no registration, and no hidden limits. You can batch rename as many files as you want, as often as you want.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: How do I rename multiple files at once?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: Drop your files into the tool, add one or more renaming rules — prefix, suffix, find & replace, or numbering — then check the preview and download everything as a ZIP. Hundreds of files can be renamed in one go.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Can I rename files without installing software?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: Yes. This tool runs entirely in your web browser, so there's nothing to download or install. It works as a full replacement for desktop batch rename utilities on any operating system.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Will renaming change my file format or extension?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: No. Your files are never converted or modified — only the filename changes, and the original extension is kept automatically. A renamed MP4 is still the exact same MP4, byte for byte.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Can I change a file's extension with this tool?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: No, and that's intentional. The extension is locked to prevent broken files — renaming '.mp4' to '.mp3' wouldn't convert anything, just create a file that won't open properly. If you need a different format, use a real converter tool instead.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Can I add a prefix or remove text from filenames in bulk?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: Yes. Use the Prefix or Suffix rule to add text to every filename, or Find & Replace with an empty replacement to strip unwanted text — like removing 'Copy of' or camera prefixes from hundreds of files at once.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Can I rename image files like JPG and PNG online?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: Yes. You can bulk rename JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, and any other image format. It's handy for organizing photo dumps — for example, numbering an entire camera roll in sequence.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Can I rename video files like MP4 online?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: Yes, and because nothing is uploaded, even multi-gigabyte MP4, MOV, or MKV files rename instantly. There's no waiting for a huge video to transfer to a server and back.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Can I rename PDF and Word documents online?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: Yes. PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and other documents can all be renamed in bulk. The content, formatting, and metadata inside the document stay untouched — only the filename changes.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Can I rename MP3 and other audio files?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: Yes. Bulk rename MP3, WAV, FLAC, or any audio format — useful for cleaning up music libraries or numbering podcast episodes. Note that this changes filenames, not ID3 tags.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: How do I make my filenames SEO-friendly?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: Use lowercase descriptive words separated by hyphens, like 'blue-running-shoes.jpg' instead of 'IMG_4032.jpg'. With Find & Replace you can swap spaces and underscores for hyphens across all your image files before uploading them to your site.

bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.q: Does it work on Windows, Mac, and mobile?
bulk_file_renamer.faq.items.a: Yes. Since it runs in the browser, it works on any device with a modern browser — Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, Android, and iOS. No app needed.
